name: Bullet Chart
summary: Actual vs. target per row over qualitative bands (poor / satisfactory / good), with an actual | variance column.
summary_zh: 逐行展示实际值对比目标值，背景为定性区间（差 / 中 / 好），右侧附实际值与差异列。
description_zh: Stephen Few 子弹图：每行一个指标或期间，灰度色带表示定性区间（默认按目标值的 90% / 100% 划分，也可用绝对阈值或每行的阈值字段），细条为实际值，黑色短竖线为目标值（一致预期、预算、同业中位数），右侧列出实际值与相对目标的差异（正负着色）。比仪表盘紧凑得多，适合季度业绩对比一致预期、各子公司对比预算、目标公司各项指标对比同业。goodDirection:'down' 用于越低越好的指标（杠杆率、成本）；scale:'row' 让不同单位的指标共用一张记分卡。
best_for: Budget / plan attainment by business unit
Metric vs. peer median with good / bad thresholds
avoid_when: No meaningful target or thresholds (use bar / lollipop)
Differences of a few % on a large base are the message (use diverging-bar or dumbbell)

target.desc: Target value (tick); or use options.target for a constant / median

bands.desc: Per-row threshold fields (ascending) instead of options.bands

highlight.desc: Boolean field marking the target row(s)

format.desc: Per-row format code field (for mixed-unit scorecards)

bands.desc: Band thresholds (ascending): multiples of the row target ('relative') or values ('absolute')

bandLabels.desc: Legend names, one per band (default derived from the thresholds)

goodDirection.desc: 'up' | 'down' — which end is good (lightest band; variance colours)

target.desc: Constant target when there is no target field: a number | 'median' | 'mean' of the values

targetExcludeHighlight.desc: A 'median' / 'mean' target is computed without the highlighted (target) rows

targetLabel.desc: Legend / tooltip name of the target tick

valueLabel.desc: Legend / tooltip name of the actual bar

scale.desc: shared (one value axis) | row (each row scaled to its own max; axis hidden)

labels.desc: Actual value column on the right

variance.desc: Variance column: 'pct' | 'abs' (in percentage points, e.g. '+2.1pp', when the values are percentages) | null

colorByTarget.desc: Colour the actual bar pos / neg by whether it meets the target

metLabel.desc: Legend name of the pos colour with colorByTarget (default 'Meets target')

missLabel.desc: Legend name of the neg colour with colorByTarget (default 'Misses target')

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to emphasise in addition to the highlight channel

highlightBand.desc: Tinted row band behind highlighted rows

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

legend.desc: Legend with bands, actual and target

interactions: Hover tooltip with variance and the band the actual falls in
Bars grow in row by row; smooth transitions on filter change

samples.title: Net debt / EBITDA vs. 2.0x leverage target
